issues.on_page: Local 1,135,520 (p4); p2 Statement of Activities: charges for services 270,085 + interest income 139,457 + miscellaneous 725,978 = 1,135,520
issues.issue: Local is 16.5% of governmental receipts in 'other'. The p2 statement of activities gives figures that add exactly to it (charges, interest, miscellaneous), and the extractor split Taxes the same way using p2. Splitting Local is defensible but not required under the split rule; a person should decide.
The disbursement category rules list noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation. The schedule prints it under the Public Works heading, so either category can be argued.

issues.on_page: p5 General Fund column: General government 1,698,208, Public safety 1,598,712, Public assistance 19,195, Capital outlay 192,320
issues.issue: The p8 departmental functions do not match the p5 statement functions. Detail general government is 1,760,489, public safety 1,727,839 and public assistance 20,107, and there is no capital outlay. The 192,320 of General Fund capital outlay sits somewhere inside the department lines (probably Miscellaneous). The schedule totals are correct (3,522,335). The extractor mentions the mismatch in notes.
